successCriteria.description: LeaveBalanceStatus enum defined with exactly four members: ACTIVE, EXHAUSTED, FROZEN, CLOSED
BalanceAdjustmentStatus enum defined with exactly three members: PENDING, APPLIED, REVERSED
AdjustmentType type alias defined as 'DEBIT' | 'CREDIT' (string literal union, not an enum)

LeaveBalance interface with fields: id, employeeId, policyId, totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays (derived as totalEntitlement - usedDays), fiscalYear, status (LeaveBalanceStatus), createdAt, updatedAt

BalanceAdjustment interface with fields: id, leaveBalanceId, leaveRequestId (string | null), adjustmentType (AdjustmentType), amountDays, reason, performedBy (string | null), status (BalanceAdjustmentStatus), appliedAt (Date | null), createdAt, updatedAt
CreateLeaveBalanceDto interface with fields: employeeId, policyId, totalEntitlement, fiscalYear
CreateBalanceAdjustmentDto interface with fields: leaveBalanceId, leaveRequestId (optional), adjustmentType, amountDays, reason, performedBy (optional)

ILeaveBalanceRepository interface with methods: findByEmployeePolicyFiscalYear(employeeId, policyId, fiscalYear), findById(id), create(dto), updateUsedDays(id, usedDays), findAllByEmployeeId(employeeId)
IBalanceAdjustmentRepository interface with methods: findByLeaveBalanceId(leaveBalanceId), create(dto), updateStatus(id, status, appliedAt)

Jest unit test at tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.model.test.ts verifying: (a) remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays, (b) CreateLeaveBalanceDto and CreateBalanceAdjustmentDto shape validation, (c) AdjustmentType only accepts 'DEBIT' or 'CREDIT'

constraints: All database access must go through repository interfaces (GP-001) — this phase defines those interfaces
TypeScript strict mode: no implicit any, strict null checks — all interface fields must have explicit types
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards where needed (HARNESS constraint no-any)
remainingDays is derived (totalEntitlement - usedDays), never stored independently (BR-002)
outOfScope: Balance controller, routes, barrel export, app registration (Phases 5-7)
Audit logging (GP-002) — not applicable to model/interface definitions with no state-changing operations
RBAC enforcement (GP-005) — not applicable at the model/repository-interface layer
Input validation at API boundaries (GP-003) — not applicable at this layer

ambiguities.description: Field types for id, employeeId, policyId are not explicitly stated — intent says 'id' but does not specify string vs UUID. The ARCHITECTURE.md conceptual tables use uuid, and the Phase 2 migration plan uses uuid_generate_v4(). Inferred: string (UUID).
options: Use string for all ID fields (consistent with UUID string representation)

ambiguities.description: totalEntitlement, usedDays, amountDays numeric precision not specified. Phase 2 migration uses decimal type. Inferred: number (TypeScript) mapping to decimal in PostgreSQL.
options: Use number with explicit rounding semantics
